paper: Distributed Risk-Aware Bidding Strategy for Incorporating Renewable Generation into Real-Time Electricity Market
note: Critical items (C1-C3) excluded per request. Fix those first.

todos.title: No convergence rate analysis for Algorithm 1
todos.description: Convergence of consensus protocols (35)-(36) is cited from Lemma 2 but no rate is given. For real-time market implementation, iterations-to-epsilon-convergence matters.
todos.action: State convergence rate in terms of algebraic connectivity (second-smallest eigenvalue of graph Laplacian). Discuss how graph topology affects practical speed. Even a remark with the standard O(1/lambda_2) bound suffices.

todos.title: Communication topology assumptions underspecified
todos.description: Paper claims connectivity is guaranteed because every operator talks to utility (star topology). But: directed vs undirected unspecified, static vs switching unaddressed, no robustness to edge drops.
todos.action: Formally specify graph type (directed/undirected, static/switching). Discuss star topology's poor algebraic connectivity. Add at least a remark on robustness to communication failure.

todos.title: Scalability not demonstrated beyond n=3
todos.description: Entire numerical section uses n=3. Theory is general but simulations don't test scaling. Reviewers will flag this.
todos.action: Add simulation with n=10-50 operators showing: (1) consensus convergence time vs n, (2) fraction of operators hitting overbid constraint vs n, (3) sensitivity of Pareto condition to perturbations at large n.

todos.title: Gaussian assumption on renewables is restrictive
todos.description: Real wind/solar are Weibull/beta distributed, not Gaussian. Entire analysis depends on covariance structure.
todos.action: Add a remark discussing which results survive non-Gaussian distributions (hint: the deterministic bidding strategy is independent of distribution shape since stochastic terms enter Pi as a constant offset) and which require Gaussianity (the specific form of the risk penalty).

todos.title: Incentive compatibility not formally verified
todos.description: Paper claims incentive compatibility but never proves: (1) individual profit under Pareto NE >= risk-neutral NE for all operators, (2) unilateral deviation in beta_i is unprofitable.
todos.action: Either prove individual rationality (each operator prefers Pareto NE to RN NE) or acknowledge the gap. Consider whether the beta allocation itself forms a Nash equilibrium in beta-space.

todos.title: Lemma 1 proof: sigma_r notation unclear
todos.description: Proof introduces x_r = sum(x_j) and sigma_r^2 = 1^T Sigma 1 without specifying that Sigma here is the n x n renewable subblock, not the full (n+1) x (n+1) matrix.
todos.action: Clarify which submatrix of Sigma is used, or define sigma_r^2 explicitly as sum_{i,j} sigma_{ij}.

todos.title: Corollary 5 is too long
todos.description: Corollary 5 handles unconstrained ERS, constrained ERS, overbidding threshold, constrained formula, and optimal beta'* all in one statement.
todos.action: Consider splitting into two corollaries: (5a) unconstrained ERS, (5b) constrained ERS with overbidding.

todos.title: Omega_s vs Omega_s^P notation collision
todos.description: Corollary 4 uses Omega_s (risk-neutral constrained set) while Corollary 5 uses Omega_s^P (ERS constrained set). Distinction never explained.
todos.action: Add a brief remark when introducing Omega_s^P explaining the notation difference (different beta values yield different saturation sets).

todos.title: Figure quality
todos.description: Figures 3 and 8 use MATLAB default styling. Bar charts lack consistent formatting for IEEE publication.
todos.action: Standardize axis labels with units, use consistent color scheme, consider combining related subplots more cleanly.

todos.title: Section VI title undersells results
todos.description: 'Illustrative Example' with 'a single instance' is weak framing for the paper's primary validation section.
todos.action: Rename to 'Numerical Validation' or 'Case Study'. Add multiple test scenarios if possible.

todos.title: Develop the mean-field limit discussion
todos.description: The observation that avg(beta_i) -> -1/(4a2) as n -> infinity has a natural mean-field game connection. Currently mentioned but undeveloped.
todos.action: Either explicitly connect to mean-field game theory literature or state as future work direction.

todos.title: Connect to mechanism design literature
todos.description: The core insight (prescribe risk parameters to achieve Pareto efficiency) is essentially a mechanism design result. This connection would broaden appeal.
todos.action: Add 1-2 sentences in introduction or after Theorem 2 connecting to mechanism design (e.g., Myerson, Hurwicz).

todos.title: Leverage Qu's cooperative control convergence rates
todos.description: Algorithm 1 applies average consensus from [18] (Qu, 2009). More specific convergence rate results from that text could strengthen the distributed analysis.
todos.action: Cite specific convergence rate theorems from [18] to address M1.

todos.title: Remove TODO comment in LaTeX source
todos.description: Line 727: '% TODO: Generate analytical figures for lemma1.png, f_b.png, g_b.png' is still in the source.
todos.action: Delete the TODO comment before submission.

todos.title: Broken reference (??) in conclusion
todos.description: eqref{eq:Pi_det} references a label inside a commented-out block. Renders as (??) in compiled PDF.
todos.action: Change to eqref{eq:Pi_i} (equation 14) or restore the referenced equation.

todos.title: J_i notation overloaded
todos.description: J_i used for both the risk-aware objective (5a) and the general objective in Theorem 1. Could confuse reader.
todos.action: Consider J_i^{RA} or keep as-is but add a clarifying sentence.

todos.title: 'biding' -> 'bidding'
todos.description: Typo: 'biding strategy' appears in Corollary 3 and Corollary 4 statements.

todos.title: Table III column misalignment
todos.description: Table III headers appear slightly misaligned in PDF rendering.
todos.action: Verify LaTeX tabular column alignment and spacing.
